name: smart-hisab-root
description: Root scripts for Smart-Hisab mobile app and Supabase backend

scripts.backend:types: sh -c 'mkdir -p mobile/src/types && npx supabase gen types typescript --linked --schema public > mobile/src/types/supabase.ts'
scripts.backend:types:local: sh -c 'mkdir -p mobile/src/types && npx supabase gen types typescript --local --schema public > mobile/src/types/supabase.ts'
